what: Behind the panel, a 2px dot is stamped on canvas in every 6px cell. Each dot redraws on a 300ms tempo (start offset random per cell), picking a fresh opacity between .04 and .20 — an even dot pattern from afar, a gentle twinkle up close. Top and bottom fade shapes overlap to frame the centered text.

options.every: Tempo at which dots change opacity (ms), default 300
options.min · span: Lower end of opacity · width, default .04 · .16 (so .04 to .20)
options.fade: With down it vanishes downward, with up it vanishes upward (original: top panel down · bottom panel up)

note: Dot color is --kf-ink. When the board size changes, the cells are laid out again (ResizeObserver). Offscreen, in a hidden tab, or with reduced motion, it paints one frame and stops

from.where: Dot patterns above and below the right panel of contact.html (two canvases 717×384 from the original sign-up page, 6 cells · 2 dots · 300ms · .04+rand×.16)
